mechanism: W-065 phase 2 round 1: the not-live answer stamped REQ-049 AC-5's 'Last updated' with the request time when no quote had ever been held (the normal first-load REST fallback); a test locked it in.

fix: AC-5's message only after a quote was held, with the newest held time; never-held uses ADR-020 Q185's draft label (REQ-049 clarification 2026-10-15).
